# Active work — lege-docwrite

Live work, grouped by parent in `ROADMAP.md` order. Blocked work names its blocker inline.

## [M1 — editor spike: one editable paged document at full speed](ROADMAP.md#m1--editor-spike-one-editable-paged-document-at-full-speed) `@docwrite.milestone.m1-editor-spike/1`

### Book model skeleton, rope-backed blocks, edit transactions and undo

`active` · `@docwrite.work.m1-model-and-edits/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m1-editor-spike/1`

Implement stable block IDs, a minimal Book/Chapter/Block/Run tree with ropey-backed text, and transactional edits with undo/redo, including the footnote slot in the model.

### Incremental pagination with convergence stop

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m1-incremental-pagination/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m1-editor-spike/1`

Paginate forward from the edited paragraph until break positions match the cached layout; count laid-out pages for the convergence test.

### Keypress-to-present instrumentation and regression gate

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m1-latency-gate/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m1-editor-spike/1`

Port lege-viewer's FrameMetrics and input-trace replay; add a test that replays a typing trace against a 500-page document and fails over budget.

### Page canvas, caret/selection painting and exact navigation

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m1-page-canvas-navigation/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m1-editor-spike/1`

Stacked-page canvas with damage tracking; exact PageUp/PageDown, spread mode, snap on gesture end; ReadingAnchor ported from lege-viewer.

### Shaping, line breaking and per-glyph atlas

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m1-shaping-and-breaking/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m1-editor-spike/1`

Integrate harfrust, skrifa, unicode-linebreak/segmentation/bidi; cache shaped paragraphs per block; rasterize glyphs through pixelkit RasterKernel into a glyph atlas.

## [M2 — book core: the first useful release](ROADMAP.md#m2--book-core-the-first-useful-release) `@docwrite.milestone.m2-book-core/1`

### Book Map sidebar with collapse and drag reorder

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m2-book-map/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m2-book-core/1`

Left sidebar listing front matter, parts, chapters, sections and back matter; drag reorder reorders the book.

### Markdown export

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m2-markdown-export/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m2-book-core/1`

Emit headings, emphasis, block quotes, images, links and footnotes; discard geometry.

### PDF export through lege-pdf-write

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m2-pdf-export/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m2-book-core/1`

Emit shaped glyph runs, subset fonts, ToUnicode, bookmarks and page labels using the upgraded lege-pdf-write.

### .legebook bundle, atomic autosave and snapshots

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m2-persistence/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m2-book-core/1`

Choose the serialization, write per-chapter files atomically, autosave off the typing path, and add named snapshots.

### Paragraph/character styles, page masters and chapter templates

`proposed` · `@docwrite.work.m2-styles-masters-templates/1` · part of `@docwrite.milestone.m2-book-core/1`

Implement the three systems, facing pages, margins, folios, running heads and recto starts, with template edits propagating to all chapters.

## Unparented

### lege-pdf-write: subset and embed TrueType and CFF fonts

`proposed` · `@lege.work.font-subsetting-and-cff/1`

Subset fonts to the glyphs used (e.g. the subsetter crate) and embed both FontFile2 TrueType and FontFile3 CFF/OpenType programs with correct widths and descriptors.

### lege-pdf-write: links, named destinations and page labels

`proposed` · `@lege.work.links-labels-destinations/1`

Add link annotations (internal and URI), named destinations for chapters/notes, page labels (roman front matter, arabic body), and streaming finalize without a fixed page count.

### lege-pdf-write: several fonts per page and per-cluster ToUnicode

`proposed` · `@lege.work.multi-font-pages-and-tounicode/1`

Allow any number of font resources per page and generate ToUnicode maps from shaping clusters (ligatures, small caps, alternates) so output text is searchable and copyable.

### lege-pdf-write: /Lang and a structure tree

`proposed` · `@lege.work.tagged-pdf/1`

Emit /Lang and a structure tree (headings, paragraphs, notes, figures) so book PDFs are tagged and accessible.

### lege-pdf-write: path operators, RGB fill and Flate images

`proposed` · `@lege.work.vector-paths-and-color/1`

Add path construction/stroke/fill operators and RGB colour for rules, underlines and ornaments, and Flate-compressed RGB/alpha images with SMask.

### Optional damage rectangles through the presenter

`proposed` · `@pixelkit.work.damage-rects/1`

Let render report damaged rectangles and let presenters use them (softbuffer present_with_damage), keeping full-frame repaint as the default.

### Enable IME and expose a cursor-area API

`proposed` · `@pixelkit.work.ime/1`

Call set_ime_allowed, forward preedit/commit reliably, and let the app set the IME cursor area so candidate windows follow the caret.

### Full text input and key events

`proposed` · `@pixelkit.work.key-input/1`

Deliver whole committed strings rather than the first char, key-up events, physical keys and the full function-key range, with modifiers.

### Input-to-present latency in FrameTimer

`proposed` · `@pixelkit.work.latency-phase/1`

Timestamp input events and report input→present alongside paint/present p50/p95/max, and record tick time instead of zero, so apps can gate keypress-to-present.

### Injectable Presenter in run_app/WindowConfig

`proposed` · `@pixelkit.work.presenter-injection/1`

Let an application pass its own Presenter (softbuffer default, wgpu later) instead of the hardcoded SoftbufferPresenter in pixelkit-shell's resumed.

### Forward scroll TouchPhase and magnify gestures

`proposed` · `@pixelkit.work.scroll-phase-gestures/1`

Keep line vs pixel deltas distinct, forward TouchPhase (started/moved/ended, momentum) and pinch/magnify so an app can snap to a page when a gesture ends.
